reason: The property type (stabilized multifamily, 40 units) fits the Conventional Properties term sheet scope (5+ units). The stated 70% LTV is within the published maximum of 80%. However, Fannie Mae requires a minimum DSCR of 1.25x, and debt service/NOI were not provided, so DSCR cannot be verified. Without DSCR, it cannot be called financially qualified. The term sheet also notes that guidelines do not constitute an approval.
missing_information: Underwritten net operating income (NOI) and proposed debt service needed to calculate DSCR and confirm it meets the 1.25x minimum
